content.comment_body: Hello all! I recently obtained a [product_name] [article_no] and am new to PLC systems. I intended to use the [product_name] as a Modbus TCP server to control signal lamps, with a Modbus client (using a Python script) writing to the coils of the [product_name]. I'm having issues connecting the client and server. I've read that not all hardware supports Modbus TCP, and the naming conventions can be confusing. My initial question is whether my device supports Modbus TCP before I attempt further troubleshooting. If it does not have the required functionality, which model would be suitable?
Your [product_name] is a current version and does support Modbus TCP/IP communication, both as client and server. Have you enabled Modbus access in the settings? Did you set up a server connection?

I've created the connection and allowed Modbus access. Knowing my hardware is compatible is very helpful, and I should be able to resolve the issue from here. I suspect it might be a firewall issue or simply due to my lack of experience. Thanks for your quick and helpful response.

analysis.insight_summary: User was unclear about Modbus TCP support for their [product_name] hardware, leading to problems during setup and troubleshooting. There is a need for clearer documentation or communication regarding supported features and models for [company_name] products. Confirming compatibility improves user confidence and helps them proceed.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects clear and accessible information about Modbus TCP support for specific [product_name] hardware models, ideally available prior to purchase or installation. They also prefer a simple process to enable the necessary server functionality.
